official_measurement_examples.name: 2022 commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2022 amendment regulations introducing gigabit-ready and gigabit-capable new-home requirements came into force on 26 December 2022.

official_measurement_examples.name: RA1 requirement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Requirement RA1 concerns gigabit-ready physical infrastructure from new dwellings toward a network distribution point, subject to the detailed statutory framework.

official_measurement_examples.name: RA2 cost cap
official_measurement_examples.fact: Requirement RA2 requires a functional gigabit-capable connection subject to a £2,000 cost cap per dwelling, with the next fastest connection considered where gigabit cannot be secured within the cap.

official_measurement_examples.name: RA1 survives RA2 cap
official_measurement_examples.fact: Developer guidance states RA1 physical infrastructure still applies where a gigabit-capable connection is not installed because the RA2 cost cap would be exceeded.

official_measurement_examples.name: Connectivity plan
official_measurement_examples.fact: Developers must provide connectivity information with building-control applications using the statutory connectivity-plan approach.

official_measurement_examples.name: Land-right tiered approach
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document R Volume 1 includes a tiered RA1 approach where land-right issues prevent infrastructure reaching the network distribution point.

official_measurement_examples.name: Volume 2 scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document R Volume 2 covers high-speed-ready infrastructure for new non-residential buildings and major renovations outside RA1 and RA2 new-home scope.

official_measurement_examples.name: Approved Document semantics
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document R is statutory guidance on ways to comply with Building Regulations; it is not planning permission or a network operator connection offer.
